title: Eldritch Occult Deity
description: A towering black eldritch entity with multiple arms holds lit candles atop a mound of dark textured matter. The scene includes scattered occult symbols, a book, and glowing orbs with bokeh effects against a dark background with faint line art.
prompt: A towering black eldritch horror deity with multiple arms and tentacle-like features stands atop a mound of dark matter, holding several lit candles. Scattered at its base are occult symbols including crosses, moons, and circles along with an open book and ritual items. Glowing colorful orbs with bokeh effects float in the dark background with faint white line art of abstract patterns.
